pr_body:
closes #7436, 
closes #7437

The order of operations was wrong, we were applying the function after the window function 

`avg(a) over (partition by b)`
would result in the polars expression `col("a").over([col("b")]).mean()` instead of `col("a").mean().over([col("b")])`

@ritchie46 i also added the pokemon csv to `examples/datasets/csv`. If you would prefer this to not be included, I can create an alternative test for this.

issue_context.title: Polars SQL: groupby returns a list when the groupby column has an alias
issue_context.body:
### Polars version checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Issue description

When an alias is assigned to the groupby column, a list is return instead of only the distinct values

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

df = pl.read_csv(
"https://gist.githubusercontent.com/ritchie46/cac6b337ea52281aa23c049250a4ff03/raw/89a957ff3919d90e6ef2d34235e6bf22304f3366/pokemon.csv"
)

sql = pl.SQLContext()
sql.register('pokemon', pokemon)

# Working OK
sql.query("""
SELECT 
    "Type 1"
FROM pokemon
GROUP BY "Type 1"
""")

shape: (15, 1)
┌──────────┐
│ Type 1   │
│ ---      │
│ str      │
╞══════════╡
│ Grass    │
│ Ghost    │
│ Poison   │
│ Water    │
│ ...      │
│ Electric │
│ Rock     │
│ Dragon   │
│ Fighting │
└──────────┘

# Returning a list -> not ok
sql.query("""
SELECT 
    "Type 1" AS type_1
FROM pokemon
GROUP BY "Type 1"
""")

shape: (15, 1)
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ type_1                              │
│ ---                                 │
│ list[str]                           │
╞═════════════════════════════════════╡
│ ["Dragon", "Dragon", "Dragon"]      │
│ ["Grass", "Grass", ... "Grass"]     │
│ ["Ice", "Ice"]                      │
│ ["Ground", "Ground", ... "Ground... │
│ ...                                 │
│ ["Normal", "Normal", ... "Normal... │
│ ["Psychic", "Psychic", ... "Psyc... │
│ ["Rock", "Rock", ... "Rock"]        │
│ ["Bug", "Bug", ... "Bug"]           │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```


### Expected behavior

The groupby column should show the distinct values only, and not a list

### Installed versions

```

Polars: 0.16.11
Index type: UInt32
Platform: Linux-5.15.90.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2-x86_64-with-glibc2.31
```

</details>
